canDoYue: 你識講房嘈同冷氣，仲識要求換靜啲嘅房。
canDoEn: Report a noisy room and ask for a quieter one.

dialogue.speaker: kim
dialogue.text: Good evening, this is Kim calling from the front desk, and how may I help you tonight?
dialogue.glossYue: 晚安，我係前台 Kim 打嚟，今晚有咩可以幫你？
dialogue.say: Good evening, this is Kim calling from the front desk, and how may I help you tonight?

dialogue.speaker: tom
dialogue.text: There seems to be very noisy air conditioning, and I barely slept in this room again.
dialogue.glossYue: 部冷氣似乎好嘈，我又喺呢間房幾乎瞓唔到。
dialogue.say: There seems to be very noisy air conditioning, and I barely slept in this room again.

dialogue.speaker: kim
dialogue.text: I am sorry for the inconvenience, and I can send an engineer to the noisy room.
dialogue.glossYue: 造成不便對唔住，我可以派工程師去嗰間嘈房。
dialogue.say: I am sorry for the inconvenience, and I can send an engineer to the noisy room.

dialogue.speaker: tom
dialogue.text: Would it be possible to move us to a quiet room, with extra towels and a blanket?
dialogue.glossYue: 可唔可以搬我哋去靜啲嘅房，再加多條毛巾同一張被？
dialogue.say: Would it be possible to move us to a quiet room, with extra towels and a blanket?

dialogue.speaker: kim
dialogue.text: A quiet room is available upstairs, and I will bring the towels and the blanket now.
dialogue.glossYue: 樓上有間靜啲嘅房，我而家帶毛巾同被上嚟。
dialogue.say: A quiet room is available upstairs, and I will bring the towels and the blanket now.

dialogue.speaker: tom
dialogue.text: The air conditioning is still not working well, so please ask the engineer to check it again.
dialogue.glossYue: 部冷氣仍然唔係好好運作，唔該叫工程師再檢查。
dialogue.say: The air conditioning is still not working well, so please ask the engineer to check it again.

dialogue.speaker: kim
dialogue.text: I have noted the noisy room already, and the engineer will visit before you sleep upstairs.
dialogue.glossYue: 我已經記低呢間房嘈，工程師你瞓之前會上嚟。
dialogue.say: I have noted the noisy room already, and the engineer will visit before you sleep upstairs.

dialogue.speaker: tom
dialogue.text: I appreciate the quiet room, the extra towels, and the warm blanket on this very noisy night.
dialogue.glossYue: 我感激你安排靜啲嘅房、多條毛巾，同埋呢晚嘅暖被。
dialogue.say: I appreciate the quiet room, the extra towels, and the warm blanket on this very noisy night.
